purpose: Identify a small subset of O0 components with reproducible conditional coefficient drift before proposing another model.

corpus.future_holdout_rows_excluded: 1952:2074 and 2074:2440 were not used to select drift candidates

method.model: multivariate logistic regression over all 13 O0 features
method.standardization: fit separately within each chronological half before estimating coefficients
method.diagnostic: compare conditional coefficients between early and late halves of five expanding chronological prefixes
method.candidate_rule: reproducible direction of early-to-late coefficient change across all five prefixes, with meaningful magnitude; bootstrap early-vs-late development-era check used as supporting evidence

team_b_recent_win_rate.interpretation: strong reproducible negative temporal coefficient drift

team_b_runs_conceded_per_ball.interpretation: strong reproducible negative temporal coefficient drift

team_b_defend_win_rate.interpretation: strong reproducible positive temporal coefficient drift, including sign transition in later prefixes

non_candidates: The remaining O0 components did not meet the reproducibility rule. Some showed large early-vs-late coefficient differences, but their direction was not stable across all five expanding-prefix diagnostics or their supporting uncertainty included zero.
important_caveat: team_a/team_b are positional representations from the O0 feature contract, not semantic home/away roles. Therefore these three positional components should not be turned directly into a production hypothesis without testing an equivalent signed/relative representation and checking that the effect is not a coding/collinearity artifact.

decision.next_step: Validate whether the apparent positional asymmetry survives transformation to semantically symmetric signed differences before freezing any O14 hypothesis.
